title: Auto Allow for Copilot Chat (Experimental)
description: An ON/OFF switch that repeatedly invokes VS Code's single-tool approval action in the last focused chat.

title: Critical Rhino
description: A warm dark and light color theme: cream on near-black, readable at 4.5:1 everywhere.

title: Browser Hub for Agents (MCP)

title: Pebble · Code Path Companion
description: Walk the path. You write the code. A pair engineer in your editor: it plans the path, prepares the structure, checks your work with your tests and helps you think.

title: Cadenza

title: CodeGraph Map
